symptom: Import/export of a Word (docx) page throws 'Export failed: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading \'toLowerCase\')'.

root_cause.location: axios error interceptor, case 404 branch (approx lines 50-64)
root_cause.explanation: For blob-response requests (docx/markdown export) that fail with a non-2xx, axios stores the error body as a Blob. error.response.data.message is then undefined, so .toLowerCase() throws a V8 TypeError whose message becomes the surfaced text via buildExportFailureMessage in export-modal.tsx. docx export always 404s in the community build (no /docx-export route), so it always crashes; JSON-response requests (docx import) are unaffected.

constraint: Reuse the existing frontend page/UI; minimal client-only change.
proposed_fix: Guard access to error.response.data.message in the 404 interceptor branch with a typeof string check before calling toLowerCase().
scope_notes: Adding a /docx-export server route is EE follow-up, out of scope (frontend-only constraint).
Complements the prior export-error.ts blob-body parsing fix; this fixes the interceptor-layer crash that loses the original error.
